text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. on the south side of Harrison Garden Boulevard be amended to prohibit parking at all times. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and will improve the sightlines of the motorists entering and exiting the driveway access at property number 80 Harrison Garden Boulevard. During the course of the investigation, it was noted that Harrison Garden Boulevard has been extended further north to Oakburn Crescent and that the existing winter parking maintenance regulation is not updated. Recommendation 4 will correct this regulation.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south and east sides of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 37 metres west of Everson Drive and Oakburn Crescent, to be in effect on the south side of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 37 metres west of Everson Drive and a point 85 metres east of Everson Drive. 2. Prohibited parking in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south and east sides of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 148 metres east of Everson Drive and Oakburn Crescent. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 85 metres east of Everson Drive and a point 63 metres further east. 4.
